bagPolicy.summary: Bags larger than A4 (over 30 litres) are not allowed, including rucksacks, hiking bags, sports bags and suitcases.
allowed: Bags up to A4 size (30 litres or less)
prohibited: Large umbrellas with a pointed metal section
bagPolicy.note: There are no lockers at the stadium. Some concert organisers set up a limited locker system, but not at every show. The list may change based on the organiser.

parking.note: Parking options and pricing are not specifically detailed. It is advised to use public transport to avoid congestion during major events.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in King Baudouin Stadium's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at King Baudouin Stadium varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by King Baudouin Stadium, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in King Baudouin Stadium's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at King Baudouin Stadium. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at King Baudouin Stadium. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
